full_prompt_en: A square painted city view shows a broad pale square or street opening between rows of pastel buildings, seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The artwork is contained within a thick black surround and a narrow pale inner margin. At the upper center, misty cream buildings rise toward a slender pale tower, its spire fading into a gray-blue sky. Roofs step down from this distant landmark toward the nearer street fronts on both sides. On the left, a rose-colored building with a blue roof stands beside cream, mint, and butter-yellow façades. On the right, pale stone fronts with dark blue roofs end at a small red-brown shopfront near the lower edge. Windows appear as small dark rectangles, and a few green awnings give the lower left a deeper accent. The open center begins narrow beneath the distant block and widens toward the bottom. Its off-white paving is lightly streaked with beige, gray, and faint green rather than described tile by tile. Thin trees stand in loose rows along either side of the open space, their dark trunks and sparse muted leaves breaking up the pale walls. Many tiny pedestrians are scattered across the square as black, brown, and occasional red strokes; no one dominates the scene. The buildings and street are painted with small, grainy marks and gently uneven outlines, creating an aged chalky surface. Overcast daylight falls broadly from above, leaving façades and paving luminous with only mild shadows under eaves and along the shops. Depth comes from shrinking figures, converging building edges, and increasingly pale distant color. A small signature-like mark appears near the lower right of the artwork, but it is not reliably legible. The overall composition is orderly and airy, with a wide white center framed by soft pastel verticals and sparse dark accents.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形城市绘画从略高视角望向一处宽阔浅色广场或街道开口，两侧是成排粉彩楼房。画作被厚黑色外围和狭窄浅色内边包住。上方中央，朦胧奶油色建筑升向一座细长浅色塔，尖顶淡入灰蓝天空。屋顶从这个远处标志向两侧较近街面逐级降下。左侧，一栋玫瑰色、蓝屋顶建筑立在奶油、薄荷及奶油黄墙面旁。右侧，浅石色立面配深蓝屋顶，靠近下边缘收于一家小红棕店面。窗户是小深色长方形，几顶绿遮棚给左下增加较深强调。中央开放空间从远处楼块下方的窄处开始，向底部变宽。灰白铺地只是以米、灰和微绿细痕表示，没有逐块刻画。细树在空间两边排成松散行列，深色树干与稀疏暗叶打断浅墙。许多极小行人以黑、棕和偶尔红色笔触散布在广场上，没有一个人主导场景。楼房和街面由细小颗粒笔痕与轻微不齐轮廓画出，带陈旧粉笔般表面。阴天日光宽广地从上方落下，让立面和铺地明亮，只在檐下及店铺旁留下轻影。纵深来自逐渐缩小的人影、汇聚建筑边线以及远处愈发淡的色彩。画作右下附近有一处签名状痕迹，但无法可靠辨读。整体构图有序而通透，宽阔白色中央由柔和粉彩竖面及稀疏深色强调框住。
style_prompt_en: This gently textured urban painting uses chalky off-white space and low-saturation pastel blocks to create an airy, ordered composition. Pale rose, mint, butter yellow, powder blue, and warm cream remain slightly grainy, while fine charcoal lines and a few dark red accents establish rhythm. Forms have simple upright edges softened by rubbed paint and atmospheric distance; remote areas lose contrast before they lose their basic geometry. Small repeated marks animate a broad central opening without filling it. Light is overcast and even, making pale planes luminous and leaving only mild local shade. Depth comes from converging edges and reduced scale rather than strong shadow. The overall effect is quiet, nostalgic, and delicately handmade.
style_prompt_zh: 这种肌理轻柔的城市绘画以粉笔般灰白空间和低饱和粉彩色块组成通透而有序的构图。浅玫瑰、薄荷、奶油黄、粉蓝和暖奶油色略带颗粒，纤细炭色线及少量深红强调建立节奏。形体有简单直立的边，被擦开的颜料和空气远景柔化；远处在失去基本几何形之前先失去反差。重复小笔痕使宽阔中央开口活跃，却没有填满它。阴天光线均匀，让浅色平面发亮，只留下轻微局部阴影。纵深来自汇聚边线和缩小尺度，而非强烈投影。整体效果安静、怀旧且有精细手工感。
theme_en: A pale town square framed by pastel buildings
theme_zh: 粉彩楼房围合的浅色城镇广场
name: Maurice Utrillo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
